# Advisories the dependency audit is allowed to pass over.
#
# One per line: the advisory ID, then a space, then why and since when. The
# reason is not decoration -- an ignore with no expiry and no author is how a
# real vulnerability becomes permanent, so anything here should read like a
# decision somebody would defend in a review.
#
# Format:
#   GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  no fix released; not reachable from our code path (2026-08-16, hadi)
#
# Prefer upgrading. Reach for this only when there is no fixed version yet, and
# delete the line the moment there is.
#
# Empty on purpose: as of 2026-08-16 the Python and npm trees both audit clean.
